description: Growth-support LP (519 reactions, 90% biomass floor) rebuilt from Human-GEM.json via fresh scipy/HiGHS LP
note: L1-minimal support sets are not guaranteed unique under degenerate alternate optima -- exact reaction-count/identity match is informational, not part of the PASS/FAIL gate. PASS/FAIL is gated on the two LP objective values (unconstrained max biomass, achieved 90%-floor biomass), which ARE unique for a well-posed LP.
